name: paseo-hermes-pack-plugin

scripts.check: check_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/hermes-paseo-check.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$check_dir"' EXIT; ln -s "$PWD/node_modules" "$check_dir/node_modules"; tsc --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --outDir "$check_dir" && cp package.json "$check_dir/" && HERMES_PACK_SOURCE="${HERMES_PACK_SOURCE:-$(pwd)/hermes}" node "$check_dir/tests/check.js" && HERMES_PACK_SOURCE="${HERMES_PACK_SOURCE:-$(pwd)/hermes}" node "$check_dir/tests/check_commands.js"

description: Hermes Pack providers, model controls, commands, and direct scheduled findings for Paseo.
